_description: Automatically expires image tags associated with development builds so that Fargate services cannot accidentally reference a bloated dev image. Apply this policy to every ECR repository used by the Fargate pipeline.

rules.description: Expire dev-tagged images immediately — cz-html-1010: dev HTML files must not reach production Fargate tasks
Retain only the 10 most recent production (untagged or semver-tagged) images; purge older ones to prevent stale dev builds from accumulating
